generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A canonical requirement can be omitted from risk saturation when obligation extraction or classification loses semantic terms before the attack matrix is generated.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep happy-path controls green while classifying rollback or historical invariants as not applicable because the canonical sentence was not extracted or tagged.
trigger_signals: risk family marked not applicable despite canonical semantic evidence

reusable_control.procedure: Rederive risk applicability from canonical source text and require discriminant controls for every detected rollback or historical-immutability invariant.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Specification extraction and attack generation must preserve semantic risk signals for rollback and historical immutability instead of relying only on previously mapped requirements.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Independent audit must rederive risk-family applicability from canonical source semantics before accepting a not-applicable classification.
